title: Stage 1 — Arrival and identity
v_on_screen: S1: day-surgery bay, patient seated, folder on the trolley, nurse nearby. S2: ED cubicle, patient curled on trolley, relative, triage clipboard.
v_patient_says: S1: "Hello, I'm here for my gallbladder operation." S2: groaning; "It really hurts…"
v_monitor: Blank until devices attached (S2 triage numbers on clipboard).
v_interaction: Wristband (rotate wrist to read), folder, allergy band, speak to patient/relative.
v_information: Name/DOB spoken by patient; folder pages; allergy details after asking 'what happened?'.
v_decision: Is this the right patient? Any allergy?
v_correct: Nurse: "Thanks, I'll update the record." Tests/medicines unlock.
v_incorrect: Reading the name to the patient → patient agrees (even if wrong in a variant) → later mismatch event.
quote: Stage 1 — Arrival and identity ‖ On screen / in front of the player S1: day-surgery bay, patient seated, folder on the trolley, nurse nearby. S2: ED cubicle, patient curled on trolley, relative, triage clipboard. ‖ Patient — what they say S1: "Hello, I'm here for my gallbladder operation." S2: groaning; "It really hurts…" ‖ Monitor — numbers Blank until devices attached (S2 triage numbers on clipboard). ‖ Interaction Wristband (rotate wrist to read), folder, allergy band, speak to patient/relative. ‖ Information revealed Name/DOB spoken by patient; folder pages; allergy details after asking 'what happened?'. ‖ Decision Is this the right patient? Any allergy? ‖ Correct action → Nurse: "Thanks, I'll update the record." Tests/medicines unlock. ‖ Incorrect action → Reading the name to the patient → patient agrees (even if wrong in a variant) → later mismatch event. ‖ Missed abnormality → Unrecorded allergy → reaction later. ‖ Escalation → Can call admissions/senior for mismatch.

title: Stage 2 — History
v_patient_says: Volunteers only the main complaint; other facts only if asked (e.g. "I took apixaban this morning").
v_interaction: Question menu or voice: pain, red flags, medicines, allergies, anaesthetics, social, fasting, pregnancy (privacy option to ask relatives to step out).
v_information: Each answer adds a line to the clerking note.
v_decision: What's the story? Any red flags?
v_missed: Yellow-eyes comment ignored → abnormal LFTs force it later.
quote: Stage 2 — History ‖ On screen / in front of the player Patient (and relative); clerking form. ‖ Patient — what they say Volunteers only the main complaint; other facts only if asked (e.g. "I took apixaban this morning"). ‖ Monitor — numbers Unchanged. ‖ Interaction Question menu or voice: pain, red flags, medicines, allergies, anaesthetics, social, fasting, pregnancy (privacy option to ask relatives to step out). ‖ Information revealed Each answer adds a line to the clerking note. ‖ Decision What's the story? Any red flags? ‖ Correct action → Relevant facts unlock correct branches. ‖ Incorrect action → Skipping fasting/medicine/pregnancy questions → blockers later. ‖ Missed abnormality → Yellow-eyes comment ignored → abnormal LFTs force it later. ‖ Escalation → Red flags → call senior.

title: Stage 3 — Vital signs
v_on_screen: Monitor, finger clip, BP cuff, thermometer, ECG leads, NEWS2 chart.
v_monitor: SpO2 + wave + HR after clip; BP after ~30–40 s; RR must be counted by watching chest; temperature from thermometer.
v_interaction: Attach devices; count breaths; feel pulse; fill NEWS2.
v_incorrect: Accepting a high BP without repeat → anaesthetist flags later.
quote: Stage 3 — Vital signs ‖ On screen / in front of the player Monitor, finger clip, BP cuff, thermometer, ECG leads, NEWS2 chart. ‖ Patient — what they say "Is this going to hurt?" ‖ Monitor — numbers SpO2 + wave + HR after clip; BP after ~30–40 s; RR must be counted by watching chest; temperature from thermometer. ‖ Interaction Attach devices; count breaths; feel pulse; fill NEWS2. ‖ Information revealed Numbers; NEWS2 total. ‖ Decision Normal? Concerning? Emergency? ‖ Correct action → Nurse sets observation frequency. ‖ Incorrect action → Accepting a high BP without repeat → anaesthetist flags later. ‖ Missed abnormality → Rising trend ignored → deterioration branch. ‖ Escalation → NEWS2 5+ → call senior; 7+ → emergency call.

title: Stage 4 — Examination
v_patient_says: Winces/catches breath when tender areas pressed (Murphy's, rebound).
v_interaction: Ask permission/offer chaperone; look at eyes; listen; press tummy regions; airway look.
v_information: Findings text (e.g. 'tender RIF, guarding'); eye colour visible.
v_incorrect: Examining without permission → patient discomfort; debrief.
v_missed: Missed Murphy's → acute cholecystitis found later.
quote: Stage 4 — Examination ‖ On screen / in front of the player Patient on couch; trainee's hands/stethoscope. ‖ Patient — what they say Winces/catches breath when tender areas pressed (Murphy's, rebound). ‖ Monitor — numbers Unchanged. ‖ Interaction Ask permission/offer chaperone; look at eyes; listen; press tummy regions; airway look. ‖ Information revealed Findings text (e.g. 'tender RIF, guarding'); eye colour visible. ‖ Decision Do signs fit the diagnosis? ‖ Correct action → Findings added to notes. ‖ Incorrect action → Examining without permission → patient discomfort; debrief. ‖ Missed abnormality → Missed Murphy's → acute cholecystitis found later. ‖ Escalation → Rigid tummy → senior immediately.

title: Stage 5 — Risk and anaesthetic assessment
v_patient_says: Anaesthetist asks: "When did he last eat?"
v_interaction: Select ASA, VTE form, airway findings.

Plan? ‖ Correct action → Plan agreed. ‖ Incorrect action → Wrong ASA corrected with explanation. ‖ Missed abnormality → Hidden fasting breach → aspiration event/cancellation. ‖ Escalation → Anaesthetist can postpone.

title: Stage 6 — Tests and moving the patient
v_on_screen: Order panel; tubes; labels; kits; ECG machine; scan request; porter; portable monitor.
v_interaction: Select tests; take blood; label at bedside; dipstick; pregnancy test; ECG; request scan; choose escort.
v_incorrect: Unneeded tests listed in debrief; pre-labelled tubes → wrong-blood event.
v_missed: Unstable patient sent with porter only → oxygen drop in corridor.

Who escorts? ‖ Correct action → Tests queued; patient moves safely. ‖ Incorrect action → Unneeded tests listed in debrief; pre-labelled tubes → wrong-blood event. ‖ Missed abnormality → Unstable patient sent with porter only → oxygen drop in corridor. ‖ Escalation → Senior for imaging choice.

title: Stage 7 — Results
v_on_screen: Results panel with H/L flags; scan viewer; phone.
v_information: Lab comments, previous values, radiology report.
v_missed: Unacknowledged critical result → blocker; real deterioration if true.
quote: Stage 7 — Results ‖ On screen / in front of the player Results panel with H/L flags; scan viewer; phone. ‖ Patient — what they say — ‖ Monitor — numbers Can update after treatment. ‖ Interaction Open, compare, acknowledge; answer phone. ‖ Information revealed Lab comments, previous values, radiology report. ‖ Decision What does it mean; act? ‖ Correct action → Plan updates. ‖ Incorrect action → Over-treating a faulty sample → debrief. ‖ Missed abnormality → Unacknowledged critical result → blocker; real deterioration if true. ‖ Escalation → Critical results → senior/anaesthetist.

title: Stage 8 — Decide, treat, optimise
v_on_screen: Drug chart, drip stand, fluid bags, medicine trolley, stockings.
v_patient_says: Pain reduces after analgesia ("That's a bit better").
v_monitor: HR/BP respond to treatment over time.
v_interaction: Recognises the need (e.g. analgesia, fluids, stockings), requests it through the drug-chart / nurse workflow and proposes the drug class; a qualified clinician confirms drug and dose; the nurse NPC administers; trainee calls senior.
v_incorrect: Requesting a drug the patient is allergic to → nurse challenges at the check; if ignored, reaction branch.
v_missed: No treatment in S2 → deterioration clock speeds up.
v_escalation: Escalation answered by NPC with advice/arrival.
quote: Stage 8 — Decide, treat, optimise ‖ On screen / in front of the player Drug chart, drip stand, fluid bags, medicine trolley, stockings. ‖ Patient — what they say Pain reduces after analgesia ("That's a bit better"). ‖ Monitor — numbers HR/BP respond to treatment over time. ‖ Interaction Recognises the need (e.g. analgesia, fluids, stockings), requests it through the drug-chart / nurse workflow and proposes the drug class; a qualified clinician confirms drug and dose; the nurse NPC administers; trainee calls senior. ‖ Information revealed Response of vital signs. ‖ Decision Safe / investigate / optimise / review / emergency? ‖ Correct action → Patient improves; case progresses. ‖ Incorrect action → Requesting a drug the patient is allergic to → nurse challenges at the check; if ignored, reaction branch. ‖ Missed abnormality → No treatment in S2 → deterioration clock speeds up. ‖ Escalation → Escalation answered by NPC with advice/arrival.
